title_en: Decision of the Supreme People's Court and the State Education Commission on Adjusting the Membership of the China Senior Judges Training Center Committee
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court and State Education Commission

Decision on Adjusting Partial Members of the China Senior Judge Training Center Committee

Fa (Xun) Fa [1988] No. 12

In accordance with the election of the new President of the Supreme People's Court and the adjustment of the composition of the State Education Commission, it is hereby decided to adjust partial members of the China Senior Judge Training Center Committee as follows:

1. It is agreed that Comrade Zheng Tianxiang shall resign from the post of Director of the China Senior Judge Training Center Committee, and Comrade Ren Jianxin, President of the Supreme People's Court, shall serve as Director of the China Senior Judge Training Center Committee.

2. Comrade Teng Teng, Vice-Minister of the State Education Commission, is appointed as Deputy Director of the China Senior Judge Training Center Committee.

June 6, 1988
